title: Earliest Known Use of Marine Resources by Neanderthals
lineage: Separate excavated assemblage on the western Mediterranean coast; its comparison with PP13B uses the published South African chronology.

passages.locator: Results and Discussion, Bajondillo Bj19; Conclusions
passages.note: Reports approximately 150 ka shellfish exploitation at Bajondillo and compares it explicitly with the roughly contemporaneous Pinnacle Point estimate.
